PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: PRE-TECHNICAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Ceramic Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Ceramic Materials.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Ceramic Materials.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Ceramic Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Ceramic Materials.

2. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

3. When learning Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools , the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   C. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials 7 3.2 Ceramics 7 4.0 Tools and Production 4.1 Cutting Tools .

4. When learning Fire Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Fire Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Fire Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Fire Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Fire Safety.

5. When learning Dimensioning, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Dimensioning.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Dimensioning.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Dimensioning.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Dimensioning.

6. When learning Plane Geometry, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plane Geometry.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plane Geometry.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Plane Geometry.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plane Geometry.

7. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Run with the tool

8. When learning Composite Materials, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Composite Materials.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Composite Materials.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Composite Materials.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Composite Materials.

9. When learning Plain Scale Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Plain Scale Drawing.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Plain Scale Drawing.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Plain Scale Drawing.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Plain Scale Drawing.

10. When learning Data Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Data Safety.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Data Safety.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Data Safety.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Data Safety.

11. When learning Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Cutting Tools 15 4.2 Computer Software 6 5.0 Entrepreneurship 5.1 Bookkeeping 12.

12. When learning Computer Software, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Software.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Software.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Computer Software.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Software.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Bookkeeping 12 5.2 Income and Budgeting 9 5.3 Marketing goods and Services 8 5.4 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Income and Budgeting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing goods and Services 8 5.4 Distribution of Goods and Services 7 Total Nu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Marketing of Goods and Services and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
